text:
alex.s: Heads up — in the token cost dashboard we're seeing NaN/$0 for some subaccounts in the Subaccount breakdown. Screenshot: https://console.redwood.internal/snap/1769951234.png :confused:
priya: which orgs? can you repro? cc @mateo
alex.s: Repro steps: Console > Billing > Token costs > Group by: subaccount, Date range: last 7d, Currency: USD. A few subaccounts show $0 or NaN while the org total shows nonzero. Example subaccount id: sub_8a4f (org 2031). I ran this ad-hoc query:```
SELECT subaccount_id, sum(token_cost) as total_cost
FROM ledger.hourly_token_costs
WHERE org_id = 2031
  AND ts >= '2026-03-09'
GROUP BY 1;
```It returned NULL/NaN in total_cost for sub_8a4f but other subaccounts returned numbers.
mateo: :eyes: sounds like a join to the price table or model_price_map returned NULL so the per-token price is missing. Can you paste a raw ledger row for the failing subaccount?
alex.s: sample raw row (redacted):```
{"org_id":"2031","subaccount_id":"sub_8a4f","model":"gpt-4o-mini","tokens_in":120,"price_per_token":null,"ts":"2026-03-12T14:12:00Z"}
```
eva.billing: I think this matches what I started seeing after yesterday's price_table migration — price_per_token is missing for some model/plan combos (reserved/EU). Checking migration logs and the price_map source now.
billing-bot: migration-job-2026-03-16 finished with 0 errors, 12 warnings. Logs: /pipelines/migrations/price_table_logs/1769948000.log
mateo: Quick triage note: dashboard aggregation currently does division/multiply with price_per_token; SQL without defensive coalesce will produce NaN/NULL rows. Short mitigation: coalesce(price_per_token,0) in the rollup query and surface a "price missing" tag in the UI. Long term: backfill price_map and re-run the ledger->billing join. I'll open a runbook entry.
priya: can we gauge impact? customers touched? priority?
alex.s: quick scan shows ~8 orgs with at least one subaccount affected; top 3 customers had small token volumes in the window. Flagged CS to proactively contact. I'd call this P2 unless it widens.
mateo: Created SRE ticket SRE-4321: "price_map nulls caused NaN in token-cost subaccount view" — I'll run a targeted rejoin job for the affected orgs and deploy a dashboard patch to show "price missing" instead of $0/NaN. ETA 2-3h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-4321
priya: :thumbsup: thanks. If CS needs a script to reconcile invoices after the backfill let me know.
alex.s: thanks team — will update thread when the rejoin job finishes and when UI patch is deployed.
